newsitem.title: USA: Texas to host biggest ever joint military exercise.
newsitem.headline: Texas to host biggest ever joint military exercise.

text.p: The world's largest ever joint military exercise will begin at Fort Bliss, Texas, this month when 30,000 soldiers, sailors, airmen and marines from four countries come together to play high-tech war games.
Fort Bliss officials said on Monday that German, Dutch and Canadian fighters would join U.S. forces for the "Roving Sands" exercise starting on April 17 and continuing until May 2.

"The units will conduct operations as they would in a real war," Fort Bliss spokesman Tom Collins said. "The purpose of Roving Sands is to allow U.S. and allied units to practice unit, service and allied coordination in a realistic combat environment."
Similar exercises have been held each year at Fort Bliss since 1989, but Collins said this year's would be the largest joint effort in the world.
